policy_text_full: Lowe's Lowest Price Guarantee matches lower prices at Lowe's or qualifying competitors within 30 days of purchase. Refund is issued to original tender. Clearance and going-out-of-business sales are excluded.
policy_text_relevant_clause: If a customer finds a lower price at Lowe's or a qualifying competitor within 30 days of purchase, Lowe's will refund the difference to the original tender.
